definitions.full: H4325. mayim II. [ מוֺ ] = מַי water . [ מַי ] 580 noun masculine 2Sam 14:14 only plural מַ֫יִם waters, water (Late Hebrew id. ; MI 23 [ ין ] מ ; SI 5 המים ; Aramaic מַיִּין מַיָּא, , Assyrian mû , plural mê , also mâmu Dl HWB 394 ; Arabic Ethiopic , plural ; Sabean [ מו ], מום plural מון , Minaean [ מה ], plural מהן DHM 6th Or. Congr. (Leiden) ii. 1, 451 f. (see on these forms Ba ZMG xiii.1888, 341 ff. )); — מַ֫יִם ( מָ֑יִם ) Gen 1:2 +; הַמַּ֫יְמָה Exod 7:15 ; 8:16 ; construct מֵי Gen 7:7 71t.; מֵימֵי Exod 4:9-10 t. + Qr 2Kin 18:27 = Isa 36:12 ; suffix מֵימַי Hosea 2:7 + 1Sam 25:11 (but read here ᵐ5 יֵינִי Ew Th We Klo Dr Kit Bu); מֵימֶ֫יךָ Exod 23:25 3 t.; מֵימָיו Num 20:8 6 t.; מֵימֶיהָ Jer 6:7 ; 50:38 ; מֵימֵינוּ Lam 5:4 ; מֵימֵיהֶם Exod 7:19 4 t.; — waters, water (c. adjective plural Gen 26:19 ; Exod 15:10 ; Lev 14:5-6 , 50 + often, so always with adjective; also with plural participle Num 5:18-19 , 24 ; 2Kin 3:20 +; with plural pronoun Num 20:13 ; 27:14 ; 2Kin 2:21 +; compare suffix Josh 4:18 ; before plural verb Gen 1:9 , 20 , 21 ; 7:17 + often; after plural verb Josh 3:13 ; Isa 28:17 ; Prov 9:17 ; Ezek 31:4 +; rarely with singular verb; before, Gen 9:15 ; Lev 11:34 ; Num 20:2 ; 24:7 ; 33:14 ; 2Kin 3:9 ; after, Num 19:13 , 20 ); — 1. a. water of a spring or well ( בְּאֵר עַיִן, ) Gen 16:7 ; 24:11 , 13 (twice in verse); 24:43 ; Exod 15:27 (twice in verse) (J), Gen 21:19 , 25 ; Num 20:17 ; 21:16 (E), etc.; for drinking, also Amos 4:8 ; 8:11 ; Jonah 3:7 + often; out of rock Exod 17:6 (E), Num 20:8 (twice in verse); 20:10-11 , (P), Deut 8:15 etc.; מְרִיבָה מֵי (RS Semitic i. 165; 2nd ed. 181 ) Num 20:13 , 24 ; 27:14 (P), Deut 33:8 ; Psa 81:8 ; 106:32 ; compare Deut 32:51 ; Ezek 47:19 ; 48:28 ; for washing (hands, feet, person) Gen 18:4 ; 24:32 ; 43:24 (J), 2Kin 3:11 ; Exod 29:4 ; 30:20 ; Lev 15:5-6 , + (P); (victims) 1:9 , 13 ; 8:21 (P); (vessels) 6:21 ; Leviticus 12:32; Leviticus 12:34 (P); (garments) 15:17 ; Num 19:8 (P); for cooking Exod 12:9 (P), compare Isa 64:1 ; Ezek 24:3 (symbolic); for purification Num 8:7 ( חַטָּאת מֵי ) 19:9 ( נִדָּה מֵי ), compare 19:13 ; 19:18 ; 19:20 ; 19:21 ; Numbers 19:31; 31:23 (twice in verse) (all P), Ezek 36:25 (figurative). b. of a river, Nile Exod 2:10 ; 4:9 (twice in verse) (J), Jer 2:18 etc.; Jordan Josh 3:8 (D), 3:15 ; 3:16 (JE), etc.; Euphrates Isa 8:7 (figurative), Jer 2:18 ; Ezekiel's river Ezek 47:1 (twice in verse); 47:2 +, etc.; of streams, canals, etc., especially, as condition of fertility Deut 8:7 ; 10:7 ; Isa 1:30 ; Prov 30:16 ; 2Kin 3:17 +, etc. c. of sea Amos 5:8 ; 9:6 ; Red Sea Exod 15:8 , 10 , 19 (song), 14:21-22 , 26 + (P), Josh 2:10 (D), etc. d. of flood Gen 7:7 , 10 ; 8:3 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 11 (J), 6:17 ; 8:2 ; מְרִיבָה מֵי (see above 1a ); מֵרוֺם מֵי Josh 11:5 , 7 ; עֵיןשֶֿׁמֶשׁ מֵי 15:7 ; נֶפְתּוֺחַ מֵי 15:9 ; 18:15 ; יְרִיחוֺ מֵי 16:1 ; מְגִּדּוֺ מֵי Judg 5:19 ; נִמְרִ(י)ם מֵי Isa 15:6 ; Jer 48:34 ; דִימוֺן מֵי Isa 15:9 ; compare הַשִּׁלֹּחַ מֵי 8:6 ; הָעֶלְיוֺן גִּיחוֺן מֵימֵי 2Chr 32:30 ; compare also proper name, of a location מַיִם מִשְׂרְפוֺת Josh 11:8 ; 13:6 . 3 special uses are: רַגְלַיִם מֵי water of the feet = urine 2Kin 18:27 = Isa 36:12 ; compare בְּמֵי מַדְמֵנָה 25:10 Kt in water of a dunghill (> Qr בְּמוֺ ); לַחַץ מַיִם water (which is) distress , because drunk in imprisonment 1Kin 22:27 (|| לַחַץ לֶחֶם ) = 2Chr 18:26 ; בְּמֵישָֿׁ֑לֶג in snow-water Job 9:30 Qr (Kt במו ; Me Hoffm Siegf כְּמוֺ ), שֶׁלֶג מֵימֵי 24:19 ; קְדשִׁים מַיִם Num 5:17 holy water (compare RS Sem.165, 2nd ed.181 , but text dubious, see Di); הַמָּרִים מֵי bitter water 5:18-19 , 23 , 24 ; compare Exod 15:23 ( הֵם מָרִים כִּי ), opposed to הַמַּיִם וַיִּמְתְּקוּ 15:25 and the waters were sweetened ; נִדָּה מֵי חַטָּאת, מֵי see above 1a ; חַיִּים מַיִם living (i.e. running) water Lev 14:5-6 , 50 , 51 , 52 ; Num 19:17 , also (figurative) Zech 14:8 (compare Ezekiel 47), and (figurative) Jer 2:13 ; 17:13 . See also below (compare Num 21:17-18 , see RS Sem.i.127.157; 2nd ed.135, 176 ). 4 among figurative uses are: a. of distress Isa 43:2 ; Psa 66:12 (|| אֵשׁ ), 69:2 ; Lam 3:54 ; usually many waters 2Sam 22:17 = Psa 18:17 , compare Job 22:11 ; Psa 32:6 ; 144:7 , or deep waters 69:3 ; 69:15 , compare 69:16 ; also מֵירֿאֹשׁ water of gall Jer 8:14 ; 9:14 ; 23:15 . b. מַיִם מֶּרֶץ 2Sam 5:20 = 1Chr 14:11 of outbursting force. c. שְׁאוֺן מַיִם Isa 17:12-13 , of rushing nations. d. of what is impetuous, violent, overwhelming Isa 28:2 , 17 ; Hosea 10:7 ; Job 27:20 ; Psa 124:4 ; 124:5 ; 88:18 ; simileof impetuousness ם כַּמַּיִ מַּחַז Gen 49:4 . e. (as running away) of heart in timidity Josh 7:5 , compare Psa 22:16 , of knees Ezek 7:17 ; 21:12 . f. of transitoriness Job 11:16 ; 24:18 ; Psa 58:8 . g. of refreshment Isa 32:2 ; 49:10 ; spiritual 12:3 . h. מְנֻחוֺת מֵי Psa 23:2 in figure of rest and peace, compare Jer 31:9 . i. of reckless bloodshed (poured out like water) Psa 79:3 ; compare pouring away (and not eating) blood Deut 12:16 , 24 ; 15:23 . j. חַיִּים מַיִם בְּאֵר Song 4:15 figurative of bride; מִבּוֺרֶ֑ךָ מַיִם Prov 5:15 of enjoyment of one's own wife; of harlotry גְּנוּבִים מַיִם 9:17 stolen waters. k. of outpoured wrath of ׳י Hosea 5:10 . 1 of abundant justice Amos 5:24 masculine of outpoured feelings Job 3:24 ; לִבֵךְ כַמַּיִם שִׁפְכִי Lam 2:19 . — Isa 48:1 read probably מִמְּעֵי for מִמֵּי ᵑ0 , so Secker Du Che Hpt Skinner , compare Di.
